QUOTE: `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c` is the library's own allocator. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`:566-600`) zeroes a static `heap` context, then calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(...)` to install its own functions in place of libc.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator installs itself via the setter from its init function, but it never says it is the only in-tree user of the setter. It also never names MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C.
